run_pipeline_generate_image: run the HunyuanDiT pipeline to generate images from text prompts with configurable resolution and guidance
create_pipeline_load_from_pretrained: create a HunyuanDiT pipeline instance loaded from a pretrained model checkpoint on GPU
encode_prompt_text_embeddings: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using bilingual CLIP and mT5 text encoders
map_to_standard_shapes: map arbitrary image dimensions to the nearest supported standard resolution and aspect ratio
rescale_noise_cfg_overexposure: rescale noise predictions to fix overexposure and improve image quality during diffusion
